build_normalizer_module: build a python module that creates a Normalizer instance with a given feature size for online data normalization
create_normalizer_with_config: create a Normalizer with custom max_accumulations and std_epsilon parameters for controlled online statistics accumulation
test_normalizer_build: test the Normalizer _build method by passing batched data and verifying normalized output with accumulated statistics
test_normalizer_inverse: test the Normalizer inverse method by normalizing then denormalizing batched data and checking round-trip accuracy
review_normalizer_accumulate: review the Normalizer _accumulate method to understand how batch statistics are tracked using running sums and squared sums
